_about: Hint text for Netplay's menus. Edit the wording freely; keep the keys. A key ending in .<platform> (tg5040, tg5050, my282, my355, h700) replaces the plain key on that platform.

menu.host: Start a session for the other device to join.
menu.join: Find a device that is hosting and join it.
menu.config: Cores, settings, debugging, turning Netplay off.

config.nickname: Name other players see when joining or receiving invites.
config.cores: Which systems play over Netplay on this device.
config.settings: Quick menu, the NextUI icon, Wi-Fi and more.
config.off: Remove Netplay's bindings; launches go stock.

cores.extras: NextUI's extras, plus emulators Netplay installs.

FC.available: Netplay plays FC with the checked core.
FC.ready: Shared screen: both devices see one console.
FC.present: This FC.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.

GB.ready: Link cable, a Game Boy each.
GB.available: Netplay plays GB/GBC with the checked core.
GB.dual: Dual instance: both Game Boys on each device.
GB.present: This pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
GB.absent: No GB or GBC pak on this device.

GBA.ready: Link: Wireless Adapter, Pokemon, Advance Wars.
GBA.paired: mGBA Dual: both consoles on each device.
GBA.available: Netplay plays GBA with the checked core.
GBA.present: This GBA.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.

MD.available: Netplay plays MD with the checked core.
MD.ready: Shared screen: both devices see one console.
MD.present: This MD.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.

PS.available: Netplay plays PS with the checked core.
PS.ready.my282: Experimental. The A30 cannot pair with others.
PS.present: This PS.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.

SFC.available: Netplay plays SFC with the checked core.
SFC.ready: Shared screen: both devices see one console.
SFC.ready.my282: Shared screen; pairs with others via Supafaust.
SFC.present: This SFC.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.

32X.present: This 32X.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
32X.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

DSP.ready: Local wireless: a DS each. Press A to remove.
DSP.off: Not set up for Netplay. Press A to set it up.
DSP.unavailable: DSperate is not built for this device.

FDS.present: This FDS.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
FDS.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

GG.available: Netplay plays Game Gear with the checked core.
GG.ready: Shared screen. Gear-to-Gear is not emulated.
GG.present: This GG.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
GG.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

MGBA.instanced: Instanced link: both GBAs on each device.
MGBA.installed: Netplay uses mGBA only instanced. Press A.
MGBA.absent: Press A to install MGBA.pak for instanced link.
MGBA.unavailable: Instanced mGBA is not built for this device.

NDS.ready: Local wireless: a DS each. Press A to remove.
NDS.present: No local wireless yet. Press A to add it.
NDS.unsupported: This DraStic build is not one Netplay supports.
NDS.absent: Install NDS from the Pak Store, then add local wireless here.
NDS.unavailable: DraStic local wireless is not built for this device.

SEGACD.available: Netplay plays SegaCD with the checked core.
SEGACD.present: This pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
SEGACD.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

SG1000.present: This pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
SG1000.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

SMS.available: Netplay plays Master System with the checked core.
SMS.present: This SMS.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
SMS.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

SUPA.present: This SUPA.pak uses a core Netplay does not drive.
SUPA.absent: Not installed. Add it from NextUI's extras.

dual.on: Both Game Boys on each device; inputs travel.
dual.off: One Game Boy each; the cable crosses Wi-Fi.
dual.unavailable: No dual-instance core for this device.

paired.on: Games set to mgba in spruce: both GBAs on each device.
paired.off: Games set to mgba in spruce play without Netplay.
paired.unavailable: No paired mGBA core for this device.

instanced.on: Both GBAs on each device; inputs cross Wi-Fi.
instanced.off: mGBA games play stock, without Netplay.
instanced.install: Turning this on installs MGBA.pak first.

mgba.remove: Put back what MGBA.pak replaced, or remove it.

netplay.DSP: Keep DSP.pak; its games play offline.
netplay.NDS: NDS.pak gets its own launcher back.

device.DSP: Delete DSP.pak. Saves and states stay.

backup.DSP: Put back the pre-Netplay DSP.pak, saves, states.

quick_menu.off: A Netplay menu over NextUI's menus.
quick_menu.on: START opens it. Press A to pick your own buttons.
quick_menu.custom: Your buttons open it. Press A to change them.
quick_menu.needs_varnish: Turning this on installs Varnish.pak to draw it.
quick_menu.unavailable: Needs Varnish.pak, which is not available here.

icon.always: An N at the bottom, lit while armed.
icon.session: An N at the bottom while armed.
icon.needs_varnish: Turning this on installs Varnish.pak to draw it.
icon.unavailable: Needs Varnish.pak, which is not available here.

compat.on: Netplay's cores when the two builds differ.

gameswitcher.on: Only Netplay in the switcher while armed.
gameswitcher.off: Netplay stays out of the Game Switcher.

powersave.on: Lower latency while armed; uses more battery.
powersave.off: The radio saves power, at some latency.

adhoc_switch.on: Disconnects from connected Wi-Fi to create Ad Hoc Network on quieter channel.
adhoc_switch.off: Disconnects from connected Wi-Fi to create Ad Hoc Network on quieter channel.

host_protocol.linkplay: Host for Netplay devices. Joiners pick the protocol up.
host_protocol.retroarch: Host for RetroArch netplay (spruce, Onion, muOS...) too.

chord.intro: Hold the buttons you want, then let go.
chord.warning: Buttons NextUI or a game also uses may do both things.
chord.refused_system: MENU, power and volume belong to the system.
chord.refused_single: A, B and the D-pad alone would block NextUI's menus.
chord.refused_axis: This device reports that button as an axis; pick another.

force_compat.on: Testing: Netplay's cores even when builds match.
force_compat.off: Netplay's cores only when builds differ.

verbose_logs.on: A complete log for each game launch.
verbose_logs.off: Turn on for a complete log per game launch.

save_backups.on: Keep original saves from the last three game sessions in Netplay/backup.
save_backups.off: Do not snapshot saves before a session starts.

debug.checks: Check bindings, paths, cores and networking.
debug.restore_wifi: Reconnect to your usual Wi-Fi network.
